features.note: Deterministic technical context from the real overnight batch. No probability, no RoR, no forecast, no order.

scale_path.note: Conditional on real account equity; holds the 2%-of-equity max-loss rule. Sizing design, not a performance projection.

wheel_fit.explanation: 2% of equity = $2000.00 worst-case position loss allowed. Any candidate whose worst-case loss exceeds this fails survivability - the wheel needs an account roughly 50x the position size.

paper_outcome_summary.note: Observed outcomes tally; NOT performance. No P&L claimed.

yellow_sheets.note: Decision ledger; not performance. No P&L claimed.

rates_environment.note: Observations of official FRED daily series. Fed funds/src curve change is a measured fact, not a forecast and not advice. No order placed.

vix_regime.note: Real delayed VIX close. Regime is a descriptive band (LOW/NORMAL/ELEVATED/HIGH), context for when to sell premium, not a signal and not advice. No order placed.

macro_environment.note: Official FRED observations (CPI YoY, unemployment, 5y/30y curve). Measured facts, not a forecast and not advice. No order placed.

oil_market.note: Front-month WTI crude (CL=F) daily closes observed from public Yahoo Finance chart data. Net change is a measured fact over the lookback window, not a forecast and not advice. No order placed; no trade authorized.

0000320193.note: Actual reported GAAP EPS from SEC EDGAR (OBSERVED, point-in-time filings). A consensus is not fabricated here; surprise is only computed when a real analyst estimate is supplied. No forecast, no order. trade_authorized=False.
